ussd.main:
Mukuru
1 Tumira mari
2 Mari yangu iripi?
3 Rubatsiro
4 Mutauro
ussd.quoteHint: Tarisa mari nemunhu wauri kutumira kwaari usati wasimbisa.

help.menu:
Rubatsiro
1 Kutumira mari
2 Mari yangu iripi?
3 Muripo nemitengo
4 Maitiro anotora mari munhu waunotumira kwaari
5 PIN nekuchengeteka
6 Taura nemumiririri
help.send: Kuti utumire mari, sarudza 1 Tumira mari, sarudza munhu waunotumira kwaari, isa mari, simbisa, woisa PIN yako. Uchawana SMS ine reference pakarepo.
help.track: Sarudza 2 pamenu huru kuti uone matanho emari yako. Uchawana SMS padanho rimwe nerimwe.
help.fees: Muripo wako ndi{flatFee} + {percent}% (unodzikiswa kusvika {roundTo}). Uchaona muripo chaiwo nemari yauchawana usati wasimbisa. Mutengo wako unokiyiwa {minutes} min.
help.collect: Udza waunotumira mari kwaari kuti aende kumumiririri neID nekodhi iri muSMS yake. Reference yoga haina kukwana. Usambogovana kodhi.
help.safety: Usamboudza munhu PIN yako kana kodhi. Hatikumbiri kwauri parunhare. PIN isiriyo katatu inokiya akaundi yako kwechinguva.

ussd.error: Basa rakabatikana. Hapana chatumirwa. Daidza zvakare.
ussd.unknownNumber: Hatizivi nhamba iyi. Nyoresa kumumiririri waMukuru.

errors.invalid_amount: Isa mari kubva pa{min} kusvika pa{max}. Daidza zvakare.
errors.daily_limit: Inopfuura mugomo wako wezuva. Daidza zvakare.
errors.wrong_pin: PIN haisi iyo. Mikana yasara: {triesLeft}. Daidza zvakare.

sender.sent: Mukuru: {amount} yatumirwa kuna {name}. Ref {ref}. {name} vachawana {received}. Chengeta meseji iyi.
sender.ready: Mukuru: {ref} yakagadzirira. {name} vanogona kutora {received} kumumiririri waMukuru.
sender.failed: Mukuru: {ref} yatadza. {amount} HAINA kusvika kuna {name}; mari iri kudzoserwa kana haina kubviswa. Daidza *130*999# kana pindura TRY kuti uedze zvakare.

sender.sent: Mhoro {name}. Mari yako ye{amount} yatumirwa kuna {recipient}. Ref {ref}.

recipient.ready: Mhoro {name}. Mari yenyu kubva kuna {sender} yasvika. Endai kuMukuru nechitupa chenyu.
